surveys.name: Plot Area
surveys.description: 2D horizontal area within the registered plot boundary (Krooki), regardless of slope/terrain.

surveys.name: Plot Coverage
surveys.description: Percentage of plot covered by building footprint.

surveys.name: Building Footprint
surveys.description: Total enclosed+covered area of building at ground plane, measured to outermost extent of construction where building meets ground.

surveys.name: Gross Leasable Area
surveys.description: Area in exclusive tenant occupation/beneficial use, including internal walls/columns. Tenancies with immediate adjacencies may include bounding-wall floor area.

surveys.name: Front of House
surveys.description: All internal areas accessible to guests: public realm, guest facilities, amenities, guest circulation.

surveys.name: Back of House
surveys.description: All internal areas accessible by staff only, normally restricted to guests: staff offices, lobbies, amenities, circulation. Excludes Internal Service Areas.

surveys.name: Gross Floor Area
surveys.description: All internal occupiable floor area, basement→roof, classified as GLA+FOH+BOH. Includes all interior wall areas not already counted in GLA.

surveys.name: Floor Area Ratio
surveys.description: Ratio of total floor area to plot area, expressed as a decimal or percentage.

surveys.name: Internal Service Area
surveys.description: All areas for complex-use support: MEP spaces, storage provisions, mechanical rooms. Included in BUA and GFA.

surveys.name: Built Up Area
surveys.description: Total constructed floor area, basement→roof. Includes GFA + ISA + ESA + parking + service areas.

surveys.name: External Service Area
surveys.description: All areas for complex-use support that are open-to-air: loading docks, rooftop plant, equipment areas.

surveys.name: Structured Car Parking Area
surveys.description: Standalone or integrated parking structure: parking bays, service areas, driveways. Excluded from GFA but included in BUA.

surveys.name: On-Site External Area
surveys.description: Area surrounding Building Footprint, within Plot Area boundary: public realm, landscaping, guest roads, on-grade parking, service roads, loading areas.

surveys.name: Off-Site External Area
surveys.description: Area between Plot Area boundary and Project Area boundary: public realm, landscaping, road enhancements, on-grade parking, site conservation.

surveys.name: Project Area
surveys.description: Plot Area + further land outside plot area, benefiting the project as agreed with local authority/third-party landowner.
